mapper.select: SELECT * FROM class_session WHERE id=#{id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_session (title, type, category, trainer_id, trainer_name, class_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, enrolled, status, gym_id) VALUES (#{session.title}, #{session.type}, #{session.category}, #{session.trainerId}, #{session.trainerName}, #{session.classDate}, #{session.startTime}, #{session.endTime}, #{session.capacity}, 0, 'OPEN', #{gymId})
mapper.update: UPDATE class_session SET status='CANCELLED' WHERE id=#{id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
UPDATE class_session SET enrolled=enrolled+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM class_attendee WHERE class_session_id=#{classId} AND user_id=#{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE class_session SET enrolled=GREATEST(enrolled-1, 0) WHERE id=#{id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
mapper.select: SELECT ca.id, ca.class_session_id, ca.user_id AS member_id, up.name AS member_name, up.contact AS phone, up.gender, ca.registered_at, ca.attended FROM class_attendee ca JOIN class_session cs ON cs.id = ca.class_session_id AND cs.gym_id = #{gymId} JOIN users u ON ca.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id WHERE ca.class_session_id=#{classId} ORDER BY ca.registered_at ASC
